_note: DATA-6. The cocktail codex (public/data/cocktail_codex_v2.json) is generated by proDataset/cocktails_v2/scripts/09-emit-codex-v2.cjs from a K-Means run over a gitignored corpus, so it is not edited. Every correction lives here, one reviewable entry each with its reason, and is applied by applyCocktailCuration (src/data/curation/applyCocktailCuration.js) wherever the codex is loaded. Keys are the drink canonical name. DATA-8 will mirror these into the pipeline.
